entities.name: Holger Granström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Holger Granström was a professional ice hockey player who played in the SM-liiga. He played for KIF. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 1985. He also played for the Finland national football team. He was killed in the Continuation War.
